title: Calendar booking
author: Atlas core
description: Find free slots in, and book into, the calendars an organisation already keeps its time in — Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online through Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace through the Google Calendar API, and an in-memory mock for trying a process out. A model names the Worker, the operation and one input object, the operation's technical capability contract input (ADR-0552); which provider answers, the tenant and the app registration live in the Worker and the vault and reach only the worker. find-free-slots lays a grid over opening hours in local wall time and offers the slots no busy appointment touches, in one calendar, in any of several (any free mechanic) or in all of them together (a person and a room). reserve-slot creates a placeholder and gives the slot up when anything else takes any of its time, so two customers never get the same slot; it throws CALENDAR_SLOT_TAKEN, which the process catches to let the customer choose again. confirm-booking sets the subject, body and attendees once the slot is certain, cancel-booking and get-booking act on the booking afterwards. The Worker reads only times and availability of other people's appointments, never their subjects.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured calendar Worker (Console → Workers) whose calendars the task uses, never a credential.

properties.label: Input
properties.description: One JSON object, the operation's contract input; a value may be an =expression. find-free-slots: calendars, from, to, durationMinutes, timeZone, openingHours, and optionally gridMinutes, bufferMinutes, minLeadMinutes, closedDates, require (any or all), maxResults. reserve-slot: calendar, start, end, optionally subject and timeZone. confirm-booking: calendar, bookingId, optionally subject, body, attendees, timeZone. cancel-booking and get-booking: calendar, bookingId.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives the slots, or the booking. Required on find-free-slots, reserve-slot and get-booking; cancel-booking returns nothing, and the compiler refuses a result variable on it.
